# OASIS UBL 2.1 schemas (subset)

Source: https://docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/os-UBL-2.1/UBL-2.1.zip (OASIS Standard, 4 November 2013), downloaded
2026-11-14. Contents: `xsd/common/*` and the `Order`, `OrderResponse` and `OrderResponseSimple` main documents,
unchanged. Used by the tests to validate the UBL order export (spec 13).
